novelty_search.nearest_results: Discovery text identifies a direct cue-term path through block8H1 at the two subject-onset destinations, but only for Tomorrow/Earlier in bare/report frames. No result tests different cue tokens and a new embedding frame.
novelty_search.new_question: Does the exact block8H1 cue-to-subject path predict the model's Later/Previously decision in fresh bare and note frames?

population: All 64 fresh A1/A2 Later/Previously rows: 32 bare frames and 32 new note frames, balanced across both transfer directions. Their complete target texts are absent from the discovery authority.

arms.full_attention: Replace all nine block-8 head outputs at both subject-onset destinations.
arms.h1_complete: Replace complete block8H1 outputs at both destinations.
arms.h1_all_sources: Install donor-minus-base H1 terms from every causal source at both destinations.
arms.h1_cue: Install only the Later/Previously cue source terms into H1 at both destinations.
arms.h1_noncue: Install prefix plus local H1 source terms, excluding the cue.

predictions.pred_a_fresh_native_capability_and_exact: Every fresh family/direction base+donor cell has native accuracy at least 0.85; source reconstruction is within 5e-4; H1 all-sources/complete selected-logit closure is within 1e-4; all rows are aligned and finite.
predictions.pred_b_fresh_cue_path_is_causal: H1 cue-only mean recovery is at least 0.10 in A1 and 0.06 in A2, with donorward fraction at least 0.75 in both.
predictions.pred_c_head_and_source_specificity_recur: H1 cue-only retains at least 0.75 of complete H1, and complete H1 retains at least 0.75 of full block-8 attention recovery, in both families.
predictions.pred_d_noncue_sources_are_secondary: H1 noncue mean absolute recovery is at most 0.35 of complete H1 recovery in both families.
predictions.pred_e_exact_zero_fit_price: Exactly 14 model forwards, 448 example evaluations, five arms, 320 arm-row records, and zero fits/searches/backwards/updates.

terminal.screen: A-E pass. Upgrade the block8H1 cue-to-subject writer from discovery screen to fresh lexical/construction identification evidence.
terminal.null: Native capability and the instrument pass but the registered H1 cue path does not recur; retain the exact fresh effects and do not promote the path.
terminal.capability_stop: The sealed fresh behavior is not natively supported at 0.85 in every target cell; report capability without interpreting causal arms.
terminal.invalid: Authority, alignment, reconstruction, closure, finiteness, coverage, or price fails.

scope: This tests held-out prediction for the identified writer path. It does not yet establish selective preservation on unrelated behaviors or composition with the downstream L9H1/H4 reader.
